params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$r='C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods-work-canonical'
git -C $r fetch origin --prune | Out-Null
$main=(git -C $r rev-parse origin/main).Trim()
$refs=@(git -C $r for-each-ref --format='%(refname:strip=3)' refs/remotes/origin | Where-Object { $_ -and $_ -notin @('HEAD','main','heaven-bridge') })
$out=@()
foreach($b in $refs){
  $ab=((git -C $r rev-list --left-right --count "origin/main...origin/$b") -split '\s+')
  $ch=@(git -C $r cherry origin/main "origin/$b")
  $plus=@($ch | Where-Object { $_ -like '+ *' }).Count
  $minus=@($ch | Where-Object { $_ -like '- *' }).Count
  git -C $r merge-base --is-ancestor "origin/$b" origin/main 2>$null
  $ancestor=($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0)
  $treeBranch=(git -C $r rev-parse "origin/$b^{tree}").Trim()
  $treeMain=(git -C $r rev-parse 'origin/main^{tree}').Trim()
  $files=@(git -C $r diff --name-only "origin/main..origin/$b")
  $logs=@(git -C $r log --format='%h %s' -n 6 "origin/main..origin/$b")
  $out += [pscustomobject]@{
    branch=$b; behind=[int]$ab[0]; ahead=[int]$ab[1]; cherry_plus=$plus; cherry_minus=$minus;
    ancestor_of_main=$ancestor; tree_equal_main=($treeBranch -eq $treeMain); changed_files=$files; unique_log=$logs
  }
}
[pscustomobject]@{main=$main;count=$out.Count;branches=$out}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress
